description: 20 sub-lattices per size k=3..9 per (run, dataset), sampled from the 16 base lattices in lattice_selection_16_cf_layer2to8.json. Each sub-lattice contains a CF; target CF depth is exactly 2 removals below the start node (layer k-2). Where fewer than 20 such subsets exist, fallback picks the closest CF depth (ties -> deeper). cf_removals records actual depth. Deterministic: random.Random(0), round-robin over base qids. k=10 cases are the 16 base lattices themselves (appended after the sampled sizes; cf_removals = 10 - base CF layer, i.e. 2-8, not depth-controlled).
